primary_metric.name: bar_height_distribution_similarity_0_100
primary_metric.definition: 100 * (1 - mean(sorted QAOA bar-height MAE, sorted RQAOA bar-height MAE)); paper bar heights are digitized only after the isolated generated arrays are frozen

targets.label: Main Fig. 1(a), n=32 QAOA/RQAOA benchmark

feature_match.reason: All 16 exact solves have zero gap; ratios are bounded; RQAOA beats QAOA in every independent instance and the mean advantage is 0.4989.

numeric_closeness.reason: Post-run paper-pixel bar-height distributions match at 97.58/100; QAOA and RQAOA sorted MAEs are 0.0334 and 0.0149.

paper_scope_coverage.reason: All 16 QAOA bars and all 16 RQAOA bars in panel (a) are independently regenerated.

targets.remaining_gap: The graph/coupling arrays and random seed behind the paper's 16 bars are unpublished, so bar identities cannot be paired one-to-one.
targets.cap_reason: The missing public sample identity makes the parameter match paper_subset even though all disclosed parameters are exact.

evaluation.pixel_status_reason: Direct pixel registration would pair different unpublished random instances; source pixels instead support a post-run distribution comparison.

pixel_migration.legacy_pixel_status_reason: Direct pixel registration would pair different unpublished random instances; source pixels instead support a post-run distribution comparison.

direct_cause.statement: T001 cannot become paper_exact because the publication omits the exact graph edge lists, coupling arrays, and random seed behind the 16 displayed instances.

root_cause.statement: The paper discloses the ensemble rule and benchmark sizes, but not the indispensable per-instance sample identity needed to replay the exact 16+16 bars.

code_fault_assessment.statement: Independent formula checks, target-level physics checks, and the isolated run attestation all pass; no reproduction-code defect is supported by current evidence.

checks.statement: The Appendix C correlation formula and recursive RQAOA logic are independently verified.
All exact solves are zero-gap, the ratios satisfy the declared bounds, and the independent ensemble reproduces the reported RQAOA-over-QAOA advantage.
The source-free isolated runner attests the exact scientific input bundle and generated outputs for both targets.
The target ledger and figure classification record that the paper fixes the ensemble rule and benchmark size but omits the exact 16 graph/coupling/seed instances required for a paper-exact replay.

The source-access boundary traces the figure PDFs into comparison-only evidence and confirms that the publication ships no author code or numerical arrays from which the hidden sample identities could be recovered.
The provenance contract binds the attested protocol configuration and separates disclosed ensemble rules from independently chosen graph seeds, optimization grids, and MILP settings.

alternative_hypotheses.statement: The current checks rule out a known implementation defect as the reason the target cannot be paper_exact.
The current independent review is stale, but that is a separate lifecycle gate rather than the cause of the paper_subset cap.

affected_scope.summary: The publication-input boundary applies to T001 only: the scientific protocol is reproduced, but the hidden sample identity behind the 16 displayed bars is not recoverable from the paper.
affected_scope.completion: 0/1 paper-exact sample identities recovered from the publication

next_discriminating_test.action: Obtain the unpublished graph/coupling samples or original author seed list and rerun the frozen isolated protocol against those exact instances.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: Either the target upgrades from paper_subset to paper_exact, or a genuine paper-vs-reproduction discrepancy can be isolated on matched instances.

physics_assertions.claim: At n=32, RQAOA beats QAOA in every instance with mean ratios 0.9839 versus 0.4850.
The independently generated QAOA/RQAOA distributions agree with the paper-pixel bar-height distributions.
